description_en: Queries the binary logs of an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL or ApsaraDB RDS for MariaDB instance, or the WAL logs of an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS MySQL/RDS MariaDB实例的Binlog日志或RDS PostgreSQL实例的Wal日志
name: DescribeBinlogFiles

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，大于查询开始时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 30 to 100.

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。

取值：30~100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: any integer greater than 0 that does not exceed the maximum value of Integer.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

BinLogFile.description_en: The details of the log files

items.description_en: The details of a log file

Checksum.description_en: The checksum. The CRC64 algorithm is used

DownloadLink.description_en: The download URL over HTTP. A value of NULL indicates that no download URL is available
DownloadLink.description_zh: 支持HTTP协议的下载链接URL，NULL表示没有下载链接

FileSize.description_en:
The size of the log file.

Unit: bytes
FileSize.description_zh:
日志文件大小。

单位：Byte

HostInstanceID.description_en:
The ID of the instance to which the log file belongs. This parameter is used to determine whether the logs in the file are generated on the primary instance or the secondary instance.
In the ApsaraDB RDS console, go to the instance details page and click Service Availability in the left-side navigation pane to view the Primary Instance No. and Secondary Instance No
HostInstanceID.description_zh:
日志文件所在实例编号，用户区分该日志文件中日志产生于主实例或备实例。
您可以前往RDS管理控制台，进入实例详情页，然后在左侧导航栏单击服务可用性，查看主库编号和备库编号

LinkExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the URL. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)

LogBeginTime.description_en: The start time of the logs recorded in the log file. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
LogBeginTime.description_zh: 日志文件记录的开始时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

LogEndTime.description_en: The end time of the logs recorded in the log file. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
LogEndTime.description_zh: 日志文件记录的结束时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

LogFileName.description_en: The name of the log file

RemoteStatus.description_en:
The storage status in OSS.

Valid values:
Uploading: uploading
Completed: upload complete
RemoteStatus.description_zh:
OSS的存储状态。

返回值：
Uploading：上传中
Completed：上传完成

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of log files on the current page

TotalFileSize.description_en: The total size of the log files

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of log files
